Title: Saulots Healing Touch - does a rescued tremere get the blood?

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
Posting this here for a quatobale source, for an answer the the rules team, originally asked on discord:

Does a Tremere rescued by a vamprie with Saulots Healing Touch get the blood?
Card text seems abigious.

Saulots healing Touch

Unique archetype.
Put this card on a Salubri you control. Rescuing a non-Tremere vampire from torpor costs this Salubri -2 blood, and if the action is successful, the rescued vampire gains 1 blood. This Salubri can add 1 blood or life to another ready minion, not to exceed starting life, as a +1 stealth action. A vampire can have only one archetype.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Posting this here for a quatobale source, for an answer the the rules team, originally asked on discord:
>
> Does a Tremere rescued by a vamprie with Saulots Healing Touch get the blood?
>
No. The action refered to is "rescuing a non-Tremere vampire", so the rescued vampire cannot be a Tremere.

Prince of Paris, France
